description: Focused desktop experience for working on Codex threads in parallel.
notes: This manifest uses the official Codex app page as a small placeholder download, then installs the Microsoft Store package through WinGet. The app is managed by Windows, not inside Scoop's app directory.

script: if (!(Get-Command winget -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { error 'WinGet is required to install Codex from Microsoft Store.' }
if (!(Get-Command winget -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { error 'WinGet is required to uninstall Codex from Microsoft Store.' }
